newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends mostly up after yen's late fall.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends mostly up after yen's late fall.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended steady to firmer except for the spot August contract on Friday in lacklustre trade, as the dollar's rise against the yen late in the day stimulated moderate short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.8 yen per kg lower to 1.3 yen firmer. Benchmark January was up 1.3 yen at 117.0.

"Although fundamental sentiment remains bearish, the rise of the dollar late in the day helped lift most prices," one trader said. Only the spot August contract failed to react to the currency market, due to technical-driven selling ahead of the spot expiry on August 25.
